Metadata.Title: Polish bro's MGS series birthday edition
Metadata.Description: Greetings everyone, Polish bro here.ICA has intercepted information about an unusual gathering in Marrakesh. A group calling themselves Golden Crescent has chosen the city to celebrate the beginning of their new alliance. Behind the decorations and cheerful atmosphere lies a dangerous plan: expanding their network through corruption, illegal trade and political influence.With my birthday on June 19th approaching, this assignment felt oddly fitting.good hunting MFs.
